QUOTE: `components/navigation_header/index.tsx` is `forwardRef<SearchRef, Props>`. When `hasSearch` is true, it renders `<NavigationSearch {...searchProps} ref={ref} />` (lines 128–135).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that NavigationHeader forwards its ref to NavigationSearch, and that NavigationSearch renders only when `hasSearch` is true. It doesn't say outright that the ref attaches to nothing otherwise, but that follows from the conditional rendering.
